visual.name: reportingGantt
visual.description: Reporting Gantt — generic timeline visual for Power BI. Activity swim lanes, chevron time axis, and milestone markers with conditional left/right labels. Data-driven: any swim-lane names, any milestone-type names (no cap). Per-value color overrides via Format pane, per-type symbol/size/color/visibility controls, custom Title card, full font controls on every text element.
